query: WITH entities AS (SELECT external_id, id FROM cala_account_sets WHERE name = $1 ORDER BY external_id DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT $2) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $3 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN cala_account_set_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.external_id desc nulls last, i.id desc, i.id, e.sequence
